name: scaling
note: run once per perturbation replica count: docker compose up -d --scale perturbation=1 (then 2, then 4), wait at least 40 s so the gateway has reconnected to every replica (check /healthz), then docker compose run --rm loadgen experiments/loadgen/scaling.json; set runs to the saturation point found by the throughput profile. The result file records the replica count the gateway sees
